data.purpose: Immutable IDs, states, hashes, and timestamps.

components.name: Primary Journey Button
components.description: The one next action in a guided journey.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:48px; border:0; border-radius:999px; padding:0 20px; background:oklch(0.46 0.14 34); color:oklch(0.995 0.004 80); font:650 16px IBM Plex Sans,sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:oklch(0.25 0.035 165); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid oklch(0.49 0.2 255); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A compact state label that never relies on color alone.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; min-height:30px; align-items:center; padding:0 10px; border-radius:999px; background:oklch(0.93 0.07 82); color:oklch(0.45 0.11 72); font:700 12px IBM Plex Sans,sans-serif; }

components.name: Atomic Receipt
components.description: Evidence values in a flat ruled container.
components.css: .ds-receipt { width:320px; margin:0; border:1px solid oklch(0.82 0.018 80); border-radius:14px; padding:18px; background:oklch(0.995 0.004 80); color:oklch(0.25 0.035 165); } .ds-receipt div { display:grid; grid-template-columns:90px 1fr; padding:10px 0; border-bottom:1px solid oklch(0.82 0.018 80); } .ds-receipt div:last-child { border-bottom:0; } .ds-receipt dt { font:400 11px IBM Plex Sans,sans-serif; } .ds-receipt dd { margin:0; font:600 12px IBM Plex Mono,monospace; }

narrative.overview: A public-service form and transaction receipt share one calm visual system. Human status and machine evidence remain distinct but synchronized.
keyCharacteristics: Deep green authority and coral action

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Coral identifies the primary next step and does not decorate the page.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: Receipts and case facts use rules, not decorative shadows.

dos: Keep transaction states visually and verbally distinct.
Keep the independent and synthetic boundary visible.
donts: Do not turn the process contract into a generic dashboard or chatbot.
